requirements.spm: Minimum 5 credits in any subjects with a minimum pass in BM & History
requirements.general_text: Applicants must meet one of the following criteria: 5 SPM/SPMV Credits, including a pass in Bahasa Melayu and History 5 O-Level Credits 3 Bs in UEC Other equivalent qualifications recognized by the Malaysian Government   Note: Forecast results are accepted. A conditional offer will be given to those who meet the entry requirements.

description: HELP's Foundation programme equips students with skills, knowledge and qualifications to pursue a degree at university. Covers various areas essential for contemporary education.
